text: -We reported last month that the Department of Justice found that Idaho segregated adults with disabilities. The department’s investigation found that most Idaho Medicaid-funded nursing facility residents could live successfully at home with support services, but Idaho limits access to services to transition out of nursing facilities and to live in the community. This is something you’ve long flagged as an issue. Has it gotten any better? -With the administration change, DOJ civil investigations are on hold. Are you concerned that that’s going to slow down any improvements?  -Let’s talk Medicaid. How confident are you that Medicaid expansion will stay in place? -How does this impact individuals disabilities differently? -On the federal level, are you concerned about any changes in federal matches for Medicaid?  -What do you think Idaho needs -Do you feel like state lawmakers are hearing concerns from the community?
